query: I have this AsyncAPI spec at `evals/fixtures/inventory.asyncapi.yaml`. Generate Drift tests for the `receiveInventoryCommand` operation.
expected_behavior: Triggers the asyncapi-parser skill to handle spec analysis
Identifies the operation action as 'receive' and determines the execution mode as async-inject
Produces an analysis section identifying 2 message types: AdjustmentCommand and ReservationCommand — resulting in 2 test variants
Generates exactly two Drift operations: one targeting :receiveInventoryCommand:adjustmentMsg and one targeting :receiveInventoryCommand:reservationMsg
Each operation includes a probe block (executable-type: command or lua-function) with correlation-id passed as argument
Each operation's parameters.payload includes the appropriate commandType const value: inventory.adjusted for adjustment, inventory.reserve for reservation
Names operations following {operationId}_{variant} convention — e.g. ReceiveInventoryCommand_adjustment and ReceiveInventoryCommand_reservation
The expected block for each test matches probe stdout JSON fields, not the AsyncAPI payload schema directly
